haiku.problem: The wrong answer "The disciples in Damascus" could be argued as right. Acts 9:19 says Saul spent several days with the disciples there, so it is not clearly false anywhere in the passage. Replace it with a wrong answer the passage clearly rules out.
The statement tests several claims at once: Ananias placed his hands on Saul, Saul's sight returned, Saul got up, and Saul was baptized. A true or false statement should test one claim.
